provenance: Synthetic Walker slice constrained by ODC filing altitude and inclination envelope; not an actual SpaceX design
orbital_model: circular two-body ECI, fixed RAAN, no J2 drift, Earth treated as sphere for LOS
limitations: All optical link parameters and scheduling policies are scenario assumptions, not SpaceX specifications.
Schedules are sampled approximations, not exact continuous-time optical contact intervals.
Link propagation delay is approximated using distance at contact start; actual delay changes within a contact.
Minimum hold is best-effort under a greedy scheduler, and may break if geometry becomes infeasible.
Sun-synchronous orbits are not faithfully modeled by the two-body propagator.
No pointing angles, laser link budget, J2 perturbation or physical acquisition model.
Trace covers links seen as scheduled at least once, not all possible pairs.
